subject: Assurance addendum: audit scope, pen-test access & evidence cadence
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Sawyer <emma.sawyer@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Assurance addendum: audit scope, pen-test access & evidence cadence

Hi Emma / Helix procurement team,

Thanks again for moving quickly here. Per our call this morning, I’ve attached a draft assurance addendum that we’d like to include as an exhibit to the MSA + Order Form. High-level asks from your side were: SOC 2 evidence access, a narrow pen-test access window, and clarity on audit rights/evidence cadence.

Attachments: assurance_addendum_v0.2_redline.docx (redlines include: SOC 2 report access, sample evidence cadence options, pen-test rules-of-engagement).

Two quick clarifying items before we put something mutual on DocuSign:
- For SOC 2, are you asking for read-only access to our auditor’s SOC 2 Type II report and associated bridge letters, or do you require on-demand data exports/evidence?
- For pen tests, do you have preferred vendors or a PoC list? We typically require a scheduled window, proof of insurance, and an agreed scope that excludes production-only admin consoles.

Can you please confirm your preference on evidence cadence: quarterly snapshot (summary + logs) vs. ad-hoc evidence requests (with 30 days to respond)? We can propose a hybrid: quarterly snapshots + 10 ad-hoc evidence items per year with a 30-day SLA.

Proposed next steps: you confirm requirements, we iterate redlines, then Rishi will finalize language for legal. If acceptable, we’ll attach the exhibit to the Order Form and request signature.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: assurance_addendum_v0.2_redline.docx (docx)]

Date: Fri, 01 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Assurance addendum: audit scope, pen-test access & evidence cadence

Vanessa —

Thanks for the draft and the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side:
1) SOC 2: we need the SOC 2 Type II report + supporting evidence (control descriptions and attachments) for the last 12 months. Read-only access to your auditor portal is preferred but not required — a secure link + NDA is acceptable.
2) Evidence cadence: a hybrid sounds right. We’d prefer quarterly summary snapshots (high level) + up to 5 ad-hoc evidence requests per year with 30 days to provide materials. Anything beyond that requires an escalation and cost discussion.
3) Pen test: we have an approved vendor list (attached). For production-facing tests we require a scheduled window (2 business days max), rules of engagement, proof of insurance, and a non-disclosure agreement.

I’ve attached Helix’s vendor security questionnaire and our approved vendor list for reference. Procurement timeline: we’re targeting signature by 2026-08-12.

Best,
Emma Sawyer
Senior Procurement Manager
Helix Health
[Attachment: helix_vendor_security_q_2026.pdf]

Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the context. Quick read-through notes (high-level):
1) SOC 2 access: we should push for read-only auditor portal links or certified copies of reports and supporting attachments under NDA. Avoid open direct access to customer-level data exports. Suggested clause: "Customer may request certified SOC 2 Type II reports and associated bridge letters; Redwood will provide read-only auditor portal links or secure, time-limited exports as mutually agreed via NDA."
2) Evidence cadence: propose language: "Redwood will deliver quarterly assurance summaries and make available up to five ad-hoc evidence requests per 12-month period. Redwood will use reasonable efforts to provide requested evidence within 30 calendar days; extraordinary requests or requests requiring large-scale export may be subject to a professional services fee."
3) Pen test: accept scheduled tests from approved vendors provided: (a) vendor signs rules-of-engagement and NDA, (b) vendor provides proof of insurance, (c) tests limited to agreed scope and windows, and (d) Redwood retains right to suspend test if safety/stability risk observed. For indemnity, we offer standard carveouts — no indemnity for pre-existing vulnerabilities; liability capped per Order Form.

I’ve annotated assurance_addendum_v0.2_redline.docx with targeted edits. If the customer insists on more ad-hoc requests, we can allow up to 10 but with a per-request fee after five.

Action items: Vanessa — incorporate Rishi’s language and send updated exhibit + pen-test scope draft. Monica — confirm whether we want a $X contingency credit or a clause for remediation credits; lean against credits in the MSA, prefer an operational playbook.

Rishi
General Counsel (acting)
Redwood Inference
